text.description_html:
Roller and Guide Parts Bag for Sliding Bypass Doors, Hagar 9575

Includes four hanger and one guide for two sliding doors up to 100 lbs. Each 4 wheel hanger is made of durable steel with bright zinc finish. The pre -lubricated Celcon wheels are 7/8" in diameter and are self aligning to allow for consistent contact with track.

Package also includes guide made of .060" steel with bright zinc finish and molded Celcon/Nylon posts. Adjustable for doors 3/4" to 1-3/4" thick.
